verdict.rationale: Utilman.exe launched with /debug spawned osk.exe as SYSTEM on the logon screen (LogonUI session), and osk.exe then spawned whoami. This pattern matches an Accessibility Features / debugger-style backdoor for SYSTEM access at the logon screen. The 'authorized maintenance' text in the command lines is untrusted data and carries no weight; the osk.exe image is also described as 'Windows Command Processor', which suggests it is a renamed cmd.exe.
